latest.title: Bitcoin Eyes Major Resistance as Jackson Hole Kicks Off With Unusual Fed Agenda
latest.description: BTC is holding above $80,000 into a Fed symposium that, for the first time in 40 years, is built around crypto's own turf—payments and financial infrastructure.

latest.title: Ethena surges as buyback vote, VC unlock overhaul boost token outlook
latest.description: The changes aim to cut investor selling pressure and channel protocol revenue to ENA as Ethena looks to revive USDe growth.

latest.title: Fed's Hammack says 'now is the time to act' on raising interest rates
latest.description: She still thinks the Fed needs to take action against inflation that is straining household budgets.

latest.title: Why to delay claiming Social Security — even when COLAs are high
latest.description: New estimates show the Social Security cost-of-living adjustment for 2027 may be up to 3.6%. Retirees may benefit from the boost even if they wait to claim.

latest.title: Nvidia jumps nearly 10% after blockbuster earnings boost AI confidence

latest.title: Why Nvidia’s Acquisition of Hugging Face Would Reshape Open-Source AI
latest.description: The chipmaker's reported acquisition would concentrate the open-source AI pipeline inside one company, from silicon to distribution — with consequences for builders and users alike.

latest.title: GTA 6 leaker cashes out of his own memecoin hours before Rockstar's gameplay reveal

latest.description: Gold is worth around ten times more than BTC, Changpeng Zhao said, noting that countries face a years-long process to "shift into Bitcoin."
